title: Size and luxury-comparison remarks
summary: This topic is loosely grouped around words like “huge” and “Flying Spur,” with examples spanning size impressions, feature overload, luxury comparisons, and a few clear evaluative comments rather than one coherent vehicle aspect.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle’s large yet graceful presence.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mix unclear or context-poor remarks about being huge, comparisons to other cars, many features, and isolated statements whose sentiment assignment remains unresolved.

limitations: The cluster mixes unrelated subjects, including vehicle size, feature quantity, Tesla comparison, and Bentley Flying Spur comparison, so it should not be treated as a single coherent theme.
Most examples are assigned undetermined sentiment, which limits confident interpretation of the topic’s overall valence.
Several fragments are too short or context-dependent to tell which specific vehicle attribute is being evaluated.
